Omar Abdullah Pitches Jammu and Kashmir for GCC Investment

Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah has stated that the region can become a competitive destination for Global Capability Centers (GCCs) from Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) companies. He advocated for attracting these companies to establish operations in Jammu and Kashmir.
